contexts.text: Spirits who supposed Heaven... to consist in being the greatest. But they were told that he is greatest in Heaven who is least; for he who wants to be the least has the greatest happiness; and as he who is the least has the greatest happiness, it follows that he is the greatest. What is it to be the greatest, except to be the happiest?... They were told further, that Heaven does not consist in this, that one desires to be the least in order to be the greatest; for then he wants to be the greatest; but it is that from the heart he wills better for others than for himself; and to serve others for the sake of their happiness, from no end of self, but from love. HH 408.
He wanted to be the least, in order to be the greatest in Heaven.
On those who want to be the greatest in Heaven. References.
Those see such a sea, with fear of being immersed, who have wanted to be great in the world...
At his first approach... they perceived... that he wanted to be great.
I will make thy name great () = glory.
Therefore all in Heaven who desire to become great and the greatest, are rejected, because it is contrary to the essence and life of heavenly love.
Such a lot awaits those who suppose themselves to be greater than others. The love of self, more than any other love, is contrary to mutual love, which is the life of Heaven.

A certain person in the life of the body seemed to himself great and wise in comparison with others; he was otherwise upright... but he had contracted a sphere of supereminence and authority... The Spirits said that they could not possibly be present; they were deprived of all freedom... SE 2681.

There is in the love of self... a kind of flaming... which so affects the life, that one scarcely knows but that heavenly happiness consists in it; and therefore many place eternal happiness in this, that after the death of the body they will become great, and be served by others...

He who fights from the love that he may become the greatest in Heaven, does not believe in Jehovah, but rather in himself; for to want to become the greatest, is to want to command others; thus he fights for command.
The Lord, in all His combats... never fought... in order that He might become the greatest in Heaven; for this is contrary to the Divine love; scarcely that He might be the least...
Hence it is that they want to become great or the greatest in Heaven...
A great river, and greatness, are predicated of (celestial things and the Knowledges of them).

He who in the other life affects the least joy, receives from the Lord the greatest; and he who affects the greatest, has the least. In heavenly joy there is never anything of pre-eminence over another...
That they might become the greatest in Heaven... AC 5120:13.
They who arrive from the Christian world think and strive for scarcely anything except to become the greatest, and to possess all things...
A great and numerous nation () = good and the derivative truth. Great is predicated of good.
From small even to great () = in particular and in general.
Because the union (of the Divine and the Human) is treated of, it is called a great feast ().
In Heaven they are the greatest who are the least.
The greater shall serve the less () = that good... should for a time be lower than truth.
The Lord teaches what greatness and preeminence in Heaven are. Illustrated.
The affection of good... and the derivative good of life is what is called the elder son. Explained.
Leah is called the elder, because external truth is first learned.
That they may become greater than others in the Heavens...

When one in the Society says of an Angel that he is the least in Heaven, another says that he is the greatest; and a third that he is neither the least nor the greatest... yet the thoughts of them all act in unity. Explained.

That to be the least is to be the greatest in Heaven... They who are solely in externals... think that the least cannot possibly be the greatest... (Yet) in Heaven he who knows, acknowledges, and believes from the heart... that no power is from himself, but that the power in him is from the Lord, is called the least, and yet is the greatest, because he has power from the Lord. AC 5084:8. AC 5428:2.
He is not great in this house above me () = that that good was prior in time; not in state. Explained.

In Heaven, they who are the greatest, that is, who are the inmost, are servants more than others, because they are in the greatest obedience, and in humiliation more than the rest; for these are meant by the least who are the greatest... Illustrated.
Only on the throne shall I be great above thee () = that it will still appear as if it were from the Natural. Explained.
Much is said of truths; and great, of goods.
He shall become great () = that it shall be increased. AC 6296.
They who love to serve without recompense... actually become great and powerful above others.
They say they are willing to be the least in Heaven; but they think, by so saying, to become great...
Here, the truth of good (is signified), because it is said a great people (. 20); for the truth which is from good is great above the truth from which is good. Explained.
It is called a great vision (), because in the supreme sense by the flame in the bramble is signified Divine truth united to Divine good in the Lord's Human.
The Lord is the greatest and holiest...
Under Moses, see this reference.
Great in goodness and Truth () = that He is good itself and truth itself.
That the Divine in the greatest and least things is the same. General article. DLW 300.
Under Degree, see this reference. DLW 225. DLW 226.
In the greatest and least things of the universe... there is action and reaction...
The love of everyone in the greatest and least things is similar to itself...
For spiritual forms are similar to themselves in the greatest things and in the least.
His Human Body cannot be thought of as great or small... Hence He is the same... in the greatest things and the least.

In proportion as these loves are not bridled, he wants to become greater and richer, and at last the greatest and richest; and even then he is not satisfied, but wants to become greater than God Himself, and to possess Heaven itself.
By small and great () are signified those who in a less and greater degree fear the Lord.
The reason the dragon is called great () is that all the Churches of the Reformed distinguish God into three Persons, and make faith alone saving...
There was given him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies () = that it teaches evils and falsities... Great is predicated of good; and, in the opposite sense, of evil.
Small and great () here mean those who are in a less or greater degree of dignity; thus (they signify) from whatever condition.
Great and wonderful () = as to love and faith... Great is predicated of such things as are of affection and love. AR 663.
Small and great () = those who in a less or greater degree worship the Lord from the truths of faith and from the goods of love. Explained.
To cry with a great voice () = from Divine zeal.
The great God () = the Lord.
Small and great = those who are in a less and a greater degree.
The reason the throne appeared great () is that Judgment is effected from Divine good; for great is predicated of good.
Small and great () = from whatever condition and quality.
A great voice () = speech from love; for great is predicated of love.

Upon a great and high mountain () = into the Third Heaven, where those are who are in love to the Lord, and in the doctrine of genuine truth from Him; for great is predicated of the good of love; and high of truths.
It is said a wall great and high (), because there is meant the Word as to Divine good and Divine truth; for great is predicated of good, and high of truth.
Have you forgotten the Lord's words, that he who wants to be great in Heaven, let him be a servant? Learn, therefore, that to reign with Christ means to be wise and to do uses...
These two loves (of dominion and of possessing) can reign more with the small than with the great...
No one (in Heaven) desires from any cause whatever, to be greater than another, but in his own feeling less...
From their disposition they appear as great, and all others in comparison with them as small...
They who utterly humble themselves, to the end that in Heaven they may be the greatest...
Very many who have been great in the life of the body (whether in dignity or learning) take with them into the other life a lofty spirit...
That he is greatest in Heaven who is least.
On a certain person who wanted to be greater.
See Charles XII.
He wanted to become great in the other life.
This is from the order of Heaven; as in the atmosphere, that the greatest thing there is as the least, and the least thing as the greatest...

Great and greatness are predicated of good; for what is great contains in itself many things (and many is predicated of truth). AE 337:end. AE 340:21. AE 372:4. AE 403. AE 424. AE 459:end. AE 514:11. AE 573:10.
It is said a great voice, because it is said of the Lord.
Great, in the opposite sense, is said of evil. AE 714.
Great () = what is remarkable.
Great is predicated of good and its affection.
Great is predicated of the affection of good and truth from which there is joy in the Heavens.
Small and great = those who know the truths and goods of the Church little, and those who know much, thus who worship the Lord little and much...
Hence it is said a great dragon; for great in the Word is predicated of good, and in the opposite sense, as here, of evil.
To speak great things = to teach evils which destroy the goods of the Word.
He does great signs () = testifications and persuasions... of falsity from evil.
Small and great = the lower and the higher ones, or the viler and the more eminent.
Great and wonderful = from the Divine Omnipotence and Providence. Great, when predicated of the Lord, = His Divine Omnipotence.
Great = completely.
For in Hell everyone wants to be the greatest; but in Heaven everyone wants to be the least.
Small and great = all who are in truths and goods in every degree... Great = those who are much in them.
